title: Arbitrum Mentorship Program: Cohort 2
description: A 12-week program run by the Arbitrum Foundation with Robinhood Chain for early-stage teams building on Arbitrum One or Robinhood Chain. It covers fundraising readiness, pitch reviews, investor introductions and hands-on execution, and ends with a Demo Day for 50+ investors. $100K in prizes go to the top-performing teams.
reward: $100K in prizes for the top-performing teams, plus mentorship and a Demo Day with 50+ investors
rules: Applications are open until December 6, 2026 and are reviewed on an ongoing basis. The post states no time zone, so EarnKit lists the end of December 6 UTC. Dates are subject to change.
Kickoff is planned for January 5, 2027; the final Demo Day is March 25, 2027.
For teams building on Arbitrum One or Robinhood Chain, or committed to doing so. You don't need to be deployed on Arbitrum yet.
The program looks for a working prototype, MVP, testnet deployment or early live product; pre-seed or seed stage; a committed founding team; a clear problem and a differentiated product.

Prizes are awarded at the Arbitrum Foundation's sole discretion, subject to eligibility, KYC and sanctions screening, and a legal agreement that may include project exclusivity, milestones or KPIs, and investment rights.
Selected teams move on to a review and interview before kickoff.
The form asks you to pick the main chain to integrate: Arbitrum One or Robinhood Chain.
ideas: A payments app settling on Robinhood Chain
An onchain lending market for tokenized stocks
AI agent tooling deployed on Arbitrum One
